split: July 1 of the preceding year; early prediction_end <= boundary; late observation_start >= boundary; remove late HARPs shared with early. Outer train and evaluation unchanged.
late_threshold_control: Frozen full-year calibrators; threshold selected on purged late half. Contains calibration/threshold reuse deliberately as recency control.
separated_calibration: Sigmoid calibrators fit only on early half; threshold selected on purged late half.
model_policy: Frozen per-year logistic and XGBoost; fixed 0.45/0.55 blend; no retraining, feature changes or threshold retuning on evaluation.
skip_policy: Keep original outer skips. If late half lacks both classes both new arms unavailable. If early half lacks both classes separated arm unavailable. Never substitute baseline.
acceptance: Require complete coverage of baseline-comparable positive years, higher precision and recall >=0.95 in each, AP no lower and Brier/log loss no higher versus baseline. Compare late-threshold control separately; no automatic promotion.
scope: Adaptive retrospective development. Comparisons alter calibration sample size and timing; no causal attribution to reuse alone.
